idea: team lead, 'cross the wall, keep the record clean': exact capped BFS restricted to P2(state) <= P2(start)+c with a loose length cap, expecting the record hump paths inside a much smaller state set than a length cap

tool.identity_check: without CAP_P2, stdout and stderr byte-identical to acc_capped (ac-07435, cap 27, MAXD 18, T8): 9,397,019 states, AC 26 PATH identical
tool.P2: P2 cut 8 (P2c of p2_hump_test.py; code copied from acc_beam.c P2 block), class-keyed cache 2^22; only multiplication children are evaluated (P2 is a class function, conjugation/inversion children inherit)

offline.method: p2_hump_test.collect_rows (all verified repo paths, board snapshot research/acc/live/boards/ac_20260928T0428Z.json.gz); hump = raw total climbs >= 6 above the start; climb = max over s_0..s_{N-9} (the states a T8-finish BFS must expand) of P2c8(s) - P2c8(s_0); full-path climbs were identical

collection.note: session-1 163-path data file is not in the repo (only path_chart_163.svg); the at-record set below supersedes it

offline.c_choice: c = 1 keeps 83% of the 59 at-record hump paths (c = 0: 66%); on all 178 verified hump paths c = 2 is needed for >= 70% (72.5%)

notes.table_note: states = stored states when the run ended (P2 runs: BUDGET 50M checked at layer end, HARD_BUDGET 55M mid-layer; reference acc_capped has only the layer-end check, hence 70M/71M). last_complete_depth = deepest fully expanded BFS layer; MAXD = max(AC record - 8, SAC record - 10) with the T8 table; exhausted_to_maxd = the whole region was searched to MAXD, so no AC <= record / SAC <= record path has its first MAXD states inside it (up to the 123-bit fingerprint caveat of acc_opt). Length-capped baseline caps are the peak of our known record path (oracle cap).

historical_length_capped.ac-03305: adaptive sweep (T9, MAXD 14): caps 24-36 empty; SAC 24 at cap 37, AC 23 at cap 40 with 133M states (556M over the climbing caps)
historical_length_capped.ac-06936: caps 25-33 proved empty; 180M budget hit at cap 34

findings: P2 <= P2(start)+c with the loose cap start+24 (the proposed rule) never reached a record: 50-55M states by depth 10-11 on all five test rows (needs 15-23). Growth 3.5-4x per layer vs 1.8x for the length cap at the known peak. c=1,2 regions contain c=0, so they stop no deeper (checked on 07435: all depth 10).
Cause 1: P2 is a class function, so conjugations (8 of 14 moves) and inversions are always admitted; with a loose length cap the region fills with conjugation padding (non-cyclically-reduced forms).

Cause 2: P2 flatness is not selective. Inside the length cap, P2 <= P2(start) holds for most states: 74% of the cap-27 region on 07435 (6.98M of 9.40M), 92% of the cap-40 region on 03305 by depth 12 (28.9M of 31.3M), 86% on 01629 cap 38, 92% on 08201 cap 36. Record hump paths being P2-flat (66%) is close to the base rate.

P2 inside the known length cap saves only 8-26% (07435 9.40M -> 6.98M, 01629 34.7M -> 29.9M, 08201 32.7M -> 30.0M; 05558 at c=3 needs the path P2 climb of 3 and still stopped at 55M, depth 15 of 16, against 70.2M for the full length-capped run).

Adding a padding bound (pad = total length - cyclic core length <= 2) makes the region small. On the one real hump row, ac-03305 (raw +16, pad <= 2, P2 flat), P2 c=0 + pad <= 2 + cap 48 finds AC 23 (record) at depth 15 with 36.3M states / 222 s (c=1 36.3M, c=2 49.6M). The length cap 40 needs >71.5M just to depth 13 with T8 (133M with T9 historically). The pad-only control (c=99) hit 55M at depth 14: P2 cuts the pad-2 region 4.5x (7.9M vs 35.5M at depth 13). SAC 24 is not in the region (best SAC 25).

The pad bound loses the other rows: their record paths carry pad 4-8 (07435 4, 05558 4 + P2 climb 3, 01629 8, 08201 8). P2 c=0 + pad 2 exhausts 05558 (42.7M) and 01629 (1.4M; pad 4: 6.3M) with no record path, and overflows on 07435 (depth 17 of 18) and 08201 (20 of 23). Offline, only 20% of the 59 at-record hump paths have c <= 1 and pad <= 2 (c <= 2, pad <= 4: 64%).

Step 4 (hump near-miss rows): ac-04346 (AC 24 / SAC 26): P2 c=0 regions are tiny and exhausted to depth 16 with no record path for pad 2/4/6/8 (71k / 286k / 1.88M / 3.07M states); c=1 or 2 (pad 4) overflow 55M by depth 12. So every AC <= 24 / SAC <= 26 path of 04346 leaves P2 <= 22 or pad <= 8 or total <= 48 within its first 16 states. ac-06936 (SAC 27): c=0 pad 2 exhausted to depth 18 (43.2M), best SAC 28; pad 4 overflowed at depth 16. ac-00487 was already tied by another lane (SENT_ROWS: ac 26, sac 27). No hits, no inbox lines.
notes.verdict: P2 as a region bound: dead as proposed (loose length cap). P2 + padding bound: a real 4-9x saving on a pad-free hump row (03305), but it contains only ~20% of hump record paths and missed on 4 of 5 test rows; keep it as an optional filter (CAP_PAD + CAP_P2 inside the length-capped sweep) for rows whose best known route is pad <= 2 and P2-flat, not as a replacement.
